title: Spicy Vietnamese Cheese Casserole
description: A spicy twist on the classic casserole, featuring the flavors of Vietnam and a creamy cheese sauce. This dish is perfect for those looking for a bold and satisfying meal.
instructions: Slice the dense bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until crispy.
Cook the spicy sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the Vietnamese fish sauce, cheese, and spices to the pan and stir until the cheese is melted.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg, salt, and pepper.
Add the toasted bread, sausage mixture, and chopped herbs to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
